description:
ReSound is the Erasmus Mundus master in sound design for media arts, preparing sound artists and designers across a European consortium led from Lisbon. The application window for the September 2027 intake opened on 19 October 2026 and closes on 12 January 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Dedicated sound-design master within the Erasmus Mundus portfolio
  • January 12, 2027 deadline for the September 2027 intake
  • Mobility across European universities with production facilities
  • Graduates work in film, games, installation art and immersive media

Who Should Apply

Applicants from sound design, music, film, media arts and related creative-technology backgrounds; a portfolio is typically central to the selection file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the ReSound website before 12 January 2027 and prepare the portfolio according to the call instructions. Key deadline information: 12 January 2027; applications opened 19 October 2026 for the September 2027 intake.
